query: What explicit item-pruning heuristics (item information cutoff, local dependence thresholds, cross-loading rules) should we preregister for EFA→CFA→IRT?

response.query: What explicit item-pruning heuristics (item information cutoff, local dependence thresholds, cross-loading rules) should we preregister for EFA→CFA→IRT?
response.answer: For EFA→CFA→IRT, use item information cutoff (e.g., loading > 0.4), local dependence thresholds (e.g., < 0.33), and cross-loading rules (no item loads > 0.2 on more than one factor).

results.content: In their chapters on multivariate machine learning algorithms, they cover various core techniques such as factor analysis (and principal components analysis), structural equation modeling, mixed-effects modeling, and finite mixture modeling, as well as alternative data types (i.e., text analysis and social networks). Finally, we focus the last two chapters on alternative data types, with an introduction to text analysis (Chapter 11), where we detail the processing of text data and implementing commonly applied algorithms, and social network data (Chapter 12), with an emphasis on network modeling. In addition to the WeChat network data, other information on each student was also collected. For example, for the WeChat network, there are a total of 165 nodes. For example, Table 12.2 shows the adjacency matrix of the first 10 students in the WeChat network data. Figure 12.4 shows the network plots of the first 15 students in the WeChat network data based on four types of layout methods.
